g.text: What a container really is: a process + namespaces (view) + cgroups (budget)
Namespaces change what a process can SEE. cgroups limit what it can USE.
OverlayFS: image layers + a writable top layer
(each container gets its own root filesystem)
docker run nginx -> new namespaces + cgroup
+ filesystem, then start the process inside them
Because NET is a namespace, a new container starts with NO network at all. Docker then connects it (veth + bridge, next diagram).
